Q183.reason: Trespass requires intent or negligence; the defect was undiscoverable, so the homeowner was neither negligent nor strictly liable.

Q184.reason: The clerk is a disinterested third party testifying to what he personally saw the testator write, so the Dead Man's Statute does not bar him.

Q185.reason: Under the UCC, a modification bringing the sale-of-goods contract within the statute of frauds must be in writing.
